name: list-tabs
description: Lists the tabs (sheets) of a Google Sheets spreadsheet with each tab's size in rows and columns, and the spreadsheet's title and link. The spreadsheet can be a URL copied from the browser or an id from google-sheets__find-spreadsheets. The tab titles it answers are what the other google-sheets tools take as `tab`.

spreadsheet.description: A Google Sheets spreadsheet URL copied from the browser, or a spreadsheet ID from google-sheets__find-spreadsheets.
